Description: Found a LinkedIn Client ID, risking unauthorized access to LinkedIn integrations and professional data exposure.
Author: Claude
Message:
feat: two-stage ICP score gates spend in the Apollo refill pipeline

Stage 1 (pre-reveal, free): deterministic rubric over Apollo's structured
search fields (persona title bucket, A1/A2 search leg, country tier,
LinkedIn presence) drops obvious low-fit candidates before reveal credits
are spent. Default cutoff 40/100.

Stage 2 (post-verify): Claude Haiku grades pain/intent evidence from the
Exa LinkedIn + news probes (reused for personalization, so scoring adds
only the Haiku call). Final score = 0.35*fit + 0.50*intent +
0.15*reachability, tiered A-D; email-cohort leads below --icp-min-tier
(default C) are parked as linkedin_only - they keep the HeyReach touch
but never consume an Instantly send slot. Intent probe is fail-open.

Score/tier/reason land in new sheet columns Q/R/S. All weights live in
src/scoring/weights.ts; scripts/calibrate-icp-score.ts mines actual sheet
outcomes (tiered positives: reply=1, assessment=3, booking=10) and prints
suggested weight adjustments per persona/country/LinkedIn/tier bucket.

New flags on refill-leads-apollo.ts: --no-icp-gate, --icp-stage1-min,
--icp-min-tier. Also fixes the anyMailFinder import casing that broke the
script on case-sensitive filesystems.
